case_title: CORREA, MARIA VS MC MAHOM, MICHAEL

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY CORREA, MARIA AS TO DEFENDANT MC MAHOM, MICHAEL ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-01-2004 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506
TRIAL RESET TO DEC-30-2004 AT 08:30 AM IN DEPT 506 TRIAL OF DEC-01-2004 IS TAKEN OFF CALENDAR
PLAINTIFF SIGNED A DECLARATION, DEFENDANT NOT SERVED.
PROOF OF SERVICE FILED ON CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF SERVED AS TO DEFENDANT MC MAHOM, MICHAEL

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF CORREA, MARIA RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT MC MAHOM, MICHAEL $3,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $40.00 INTEREST, $22.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $3,062.00, DEFENDANT HAS NOT COMPLIED WITH CC 1950.5 IN NOT RETURNING PLAINTIFF'S $2000 SECURITY DEPOSIT. DEFENDANT ACTED IN BAD FAITH IN ITS CLAIM AND RETENTION OF THE SECURITY DEPOSIT UNDER CC 1950.5 (E) AND THE COURT AWARDS PLAINTIFF $1000 FOR DEFENDANT'S BAD FAITH. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
